full_page.content:
1956, April 1
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten origi- nal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Easter Sunday - April Ist 1956 - 8:45 PM.
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you Miss Loretta Mry Gibson God bless you and yours these unsettled days - glorious days, however as always, for men of good will. .... for men who can humbly appreciate what enables them - us poor sinners - to glory in actually holding a place of trust Even near - at least in sight of - the General - our crucified Jesus.
I am sending you a copy of the, "Prayer for Peace," of which you have likely known away ahead of me. I heard it first, only after coming to St. Bonaventures last January. . It strck me at once as from a saddened heart. My own heart filled up, at my first official praying thereof.
(Unfinished draft)
